test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: What is the purpose of the issue of Mandamus?

options.text: Directing an official for the performance of a duty
Release of an illegally detained person
Transferring of a case from an inferior court to a court of higher jurisdiction
Calling upon one to show as to by what authority he holds or claims a franchise or office

solution:
The correct answer is __**Directing an official for the performance of a duty.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Mandamus **literally means ‘we command’.
 
• It is a **command issued by the court to a public official asking him to perform the official duties** that he has failed or refused to perform.
